HTML_TEXT:
Tiny Lemon Shopify App for AI Model Photos TinyLemon Features Pricing Guides About Contact Log in Install app View demo For indie fashion brands on Shopify Studio shots in 60 seconds. No shoot. Upload a flat-lay from your factory or your own shoot. Get professional on-model photos, ready to publish on Shopify. No photographer, no shoot budget. Tiny Lemon is available on the Shopify App Store. Install from Shopify App Store View demo Drag to compare Studio shot Flat lay Studio shot Flat lay How it works 1 Upload your flat-lay — from your factory, supplier, or your own shoot 2 Get a full set of on-model photos in minutes 3 Add to your Shopify products and publish All features in 1 tool Discover features that simplify workflows and grow your business. Flat-lay to studio in minutes Upload a flat-lay photo. We generate on-model shots so the product looks the same as in real life, fabric, fit, and construction, without a photoshoot. Built for Shopify Install Tiny Lemon from the Shopify App Store to generate images in the app and add them directly to your Shopify products. No export, no manual uploads, same look every time. Your model, your style Pick a styling direction that matches your brand — Editorial Cool (Zara, Reformation), Minimal Clarity (COS, Arket), Street Aesthetic (Urban Outfitters, Carhartt), and more. Every shot reflects your brand identity, not a generic template. Every photo your listing needs On-model front, side, and back views, detail close-ups, flat lay, and lifestyle. Each tier unlocks more of the set for your store. FAQ Is Tiny Lemon a Shopify app? Yes. Tiny Lemon is a Shopify app for fashion stores that turns flat-lay and supplier photos into AI model photos and short product videos for Shopify product listings. What does Tiny Lemon do? Tiny Lemon helps Shopify clothing stores turn flat-lay or supplier product photos into on-model product photos and short product videos without booking a photographer, model, or studio shoot. Add Tiny Lemon to Shopify Install Tiny Lemon from the Shopify App Store to generate AI model photos and product videos directly inside Shopify. Install from Shopify App Store Already installed? Open Tiny Lemon from your Shopify admin under Apps. TinyLemon Beautiful product photos in minutes. For fashion brands on Shopify.
